mathematical_signal_first.boundary: This is the classical full-support theorem, not universal Erdos #257.
This is the pairwise-coprime support theorem, not universal Erdos #257; the infinitude, pairwise-coprimality, and summable-reciprocal hypotheses remain explicit.

This is a conditional reduction: the bouquet structure and uniform tail-selection predicate remain hypotheses; neither is constructed for arbitrary supports, so this does not add an unconditional Erdos #257 support family or solve the universal problem.

This is the nonnegative rational eventually-periodic coefficient theorem; its nonnegativity, eventual periodicity, and positive-tail hypotheses remain explicit, and the broader mixed-sign periodic theorem is not claimed.

The cofinal separation supply is an open premise, stronger than mere non-integrality; this sufficient route is not an equivalence and leaves the punctured/top-edge boundary and the Erdős #249 endpoint open.

The four-term decomposition and 9X/10 gap remain conditional on the explicit dyadic-room and PivotBudgetAt hypotheses; the cofinal decorrelation producer is unproved. The fibre/image lemmas do not give global supplier-prime isolation or a prime-distribution estimate, and no Erdős #249 irrationality conclusion is claimed.

The phase-density, cofinal natural-prime strict-gap, associated uniform-margin, and cofinal nonpositive-prime-shift producers remain unproved for the actual totient orbit. Exact phase/integrality equivalence, finite dyadic-root exclusion for 1 ≤ h ≤ 16 and k ≤ 14, and non-dyadicity-to-cofinal-nonpositive-phase implications are classification or finite evidence only; they do not supply density or prime alignment, and the source does not prove actual root entry. This is a conditional reduction only: no unconditional Erdős #249 endpoint, novelty, priority, significance, or external-review claim is made. It is distinct from the finite first_harmonic_pivot_decomposition and actual_lcm_orbit_separation families.
The equivalence does not supply a cofinal carry producer.
The equivalence does not prove irrationality of either series.

This is a necessary consequence of rationality only: it gives no contradiction, no finite-rank upper bound for a rationality-supplied carry, and no irrationality proof for Erdős #249. Modulo a divisor of the multiplier, the forcing disappears and the carry becomes geometric, so quotient periodicity alone supplies no finite-ℚ-rank upper bound. The coefficient-side kernel-rank and certificate-equivalence families are not duplicated, and #249 remains open.

This exact endpoint-socket classification does not supply any unbounded terminal-false or upper-or-middle occurrences, cofinal supply, skipped-support producer, or half-membership witness; finite exact rows do not establish the required global supply. It is not an unconditional or universal Erdős #257 result, and no novelty, priority, significance, or external-review claim is made.

This is a conditional recovery criterion: the source theorem assumes every displayed dynamics, positivity, strict centered-step, normalized-vanishing, and summability hypothesis, and does not prove them for the original Erdős #243 orbit. Any surviving canonical orbit must have divergent normalized negative mass. It supplies no prime-specific producer, unconditional #243 endpoint, or reciprocal-tail irrationality, and makes no novelty, priority, significance, or external-review claim. It is distinct from centered_state_dynamics, which uses a uniform lower-bound hypothesis rather than summability of normalized negative mass.

remaining_open_propositions.statement: Prove that S = ∑ φ(n)/2ⁿ is irrational, with no bound on a possible rational denominator.
Prove that Π = ∑_{n≥1} p_n/2ⁿ is irrational; the exact tail-shift equivalence and prime-gap constraints do not supply the required cofinal escape.
Produce certified non-integrality witnesses at unbounded parameters. A sufficient one-parameter form is to produce them along the lcm diagonal.
Decide whether 1/2 lies in the Mersenne achievement set. Yes refutes universal #257; no closes only this route.

Decide the exact 1/21 branch: equivalently, exclude the fatal/cofinite/aligned branch, contradict its eventual permanent affine-supercapacity recurrence, prove cofinally bounded scaled greedy remainders, or force an unbounded sequence of closed canonical quotient rows. A positive membership result would refute universal #257; no such producer is proved.
Prove irrationality for every infinite support A, not only the named support families formalised here.
Determine irrationality of the running-LCM reciprocal sum for finite prime sets of size at least three; the rationality-to-carry bridge and cofinal window escape remain open.
Find or refute the required short curve between two roots inside the open lemniscate; finite ray separation and perturbative root retention do not supply the global topology and length argument.
Determine whether F(t) = ∑_{n≥1} 1/(tⁿ − 1) is irrational for every rational t > 1; the checked base-3/2 exclusions and exact tail recurrence do not decide the endpoint or the universal assertion.

Prove the Erdős #243 assertion: if 1 ≤ a₁ < a₂ < ··· has aₙ/aₙ₋₁² → 1 and rational reciprocal sum, then aₙ = aₙ₋₁² − aₙ₋₁ + 1 eventually; the checked barrier does not settle the mixed-sign unbounded regime.
Prove that B·T_a ∉ ℤ for every B ≥ 1 coprime to 30 and every a ≥ 1.
Prove that for every B ≥ 1 coprime to 30 and every a₀ ≥ 1 there are ℓ ≥ a₀ and h ≥ 1 with lpr_{W(ℓ,h)}(−B·F(ℓ,h)) > K^235(B, ℓ+h).

Represent D_{2,3,5} faithfully by a specified two-dimensional Mahler-type value theorem with every hypothesis verified, give a conditional theorem under explicit logarithmic nondegeneracy, or prove no such representation exists.
Decide whether every nonterminal canonical orbit of the reduced-orbit problem has limsup_n (log M_n)/n > 0, equivalently 2^n ≤ M_n^K infinitely often for some K ≥ 1.
Decide whether, for each h ≥ 1, some s ≥ 1 and 0 < η < 1 give, for every X₀, admissible X and L meeting the displayed size conditions for which the four first-harmonic bounds hold.
Decide whether the scaled actual greedy remainder returns cofinally to one bounded interval: whether some B < ∞ has 2^N r_N ≤ B at arbitrarily large N.
Decide whether a bounded-memory 2-adic or discrepancy invariant of the actual support forces a closed return or forbids permanent supercapacity, or prove no such invariant exists.
Decide whether the final-skip signatures prove |E − a_M| ≥ gap_M, contradicting 0 < a_M − E < gap_M, for E = ∑_{n≥1}(2^n − 1)^{−1} and the last-skip approximant a_M.

mathematical_programmes.title: Achievement-set geometry and the rational-target seams
mathematical_programmes.mathematical_focus: Greedy coding, exact achievement-set geometry, dyadic skip bands and seam classification for 1/2, conditional terminal-scaled and cofinal-cylinder rational-half frontiers, plus the canonical quotient-greedy, scaled-remainder, final-skip and permanent affine-supercapacity frontier for 1/21.
mathematical_programmes.claim_ceiling: Exact geometry and reductions for the 1/2 and 1/21 branches; neither target membership nor universal Erdős #257 is proved.

mathematical_programmes.title: #249 certificate and harmonic interface
mathematical_programmes.mathematical_focus: Tail-difference certificates, exact completeness at fixed parameters, bounded lcm-diagonal instances, first-harmonic consumers, and the exact four-term pivot budget.
mathematical_programmes.claim_ceiling: The certificate formulation is exact and finite instances are checked; the unbounded certificate supply and irrationality of S remain open.

mathematical_programmes.title: Classical and structured support irrationality
mathematical_programmes.mathematical_focus: Classical full support, structured infinite supports, periodic nonnegative weights, signed periodic obstructions, and orthogonal-petal support combinatorics.
mathematical_programmes.claim_ceiling: These are structured families, coefficient classes, and a conditional bouquet reduction; arbitrary infinite supports in universal Erdős #257 remain open.

mathematical_programmes.title: #249 diagonal arithmetic and fresh-loss interfaces
mathematical_programmes.mathematical_focus: Exact interval avoidance on the lcm diagonal, fresh-prime endpoint defects, binary suffix arithmetic, affine escape sockets, and finite residue projections.
mathematical_programmes.claim_ceiling: Each interface sharpens or re-expresses the same supply problem; no unbounded avoidance, slack, or separated-projection supply is proved.

mathematical_programmes.title: Boolean Möbius carry and global rationality constraints
mathematical_programmes.mathematical_focus: Tempered binary carry orbits, Boolean Möbius reconstruction, reciprocal mass, unbounded carry states, and sublogarithmic divisor-coverage windows.
mathematical_programmes.claim_ceiling: These are exact characterisations and necessary consequences of rationality; they do not contradict every hypothetical rational value or settle universal Erdős #257.

mathematical_programmes.title: Transport, curvature, phase separation, and no-go results
mathematical_programmes.mathematical_focus: Finite differences of totient tails, actual-LCM orbit sign and top-edge boundaries, exponent transport, affine moment annihilation, the exact first-harmonic pivot budget, harmonic phases, reconstruction defects, and countermodels to bounded local signatures.
mathematical_programmes.claim_ceiling: The actual-LCM frontier, corridor, consumers, and countermodels are exact, but no cofinal curvature, transport, phase-separation, or anti-reconstruction producer is proved.

mathematical_programmes.title: Mersenne–Lambert identities and obstruction interfaces
mathematical_programmes.mathematical_focus: Dirichlet convolution identities, the Möbius-square lens, primitive-coordinate finite jets, exact tail atoms, sign-support no-go results, and conditional carry-rank growth.
mathematical_programmes.claim_ceiling: These are exact identities, obstruction theorems, and one conditional rank consequence; they do not form an irrationality criterion for S.

mathematical_programmes.title: Coprimality probability, gcd moments, and Stern–Brocot geometry
mathematical_programmes.mathematical_focus: Fair-coin gcd distributions, squared-Mersenne Lambert transforms, Pillai's gcd-sum function, Stern–Brocot cylinder measures, and Fibonacci/continuant run stability.
mathematical_programmes.claim_ceiling: Exact identities, denominator transfer, convergence, and combinatorial stability only; no irrationality or novelty claim.

mathematical_programmes.title: Half-carry compactness, windows, seams, and finite propagation
mathematical_programmes.mathematical_focus: Exact dyadic prefix coordinates, compactness from finite half-carry words, protected seams, inverse-parent contraction, suffix-cylinder propagation, and checked stages through depth 52.
mathematical_programmes.claim_ceiling: The closure implications, local propagation laws, and bounded stages are exact; no cofinal or coherent unbounded window family is proved, so neither half-membership nor universal Erdős #257 follows.

mathematical_programmes.title: Denominator, CRT, moment, and gauge obstructions
mathematical_programmes.mathematical_focus: Squared-Mersenne tail enclosures, exact reduced denominators, adelic divisibility, square-CRT correction removal, dyadic determinant substrate, certificate dimensions, and residual-gauge no-go results.
mathematical_programmes.claim_ceiling: These are exact arithmetic interfaces, finite mechanisms, and obstruction theorems; they do not supply an unbounded certificate family or an irrationality criterion for the totient constant.
